caseName: National Union of Hospital & Nursing Home Employees v. Bluefield Sanitarium, Inc.
caseNameFull: National Union of Hospital & Nursing Home Employees, AFL-CIO, RWDSU, Local 1199-W. Va. v. Bluefield Sanitarium, Inc.

opinions.text: Appeal from Sup. Ct. Va. dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as á petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.
